lines.en:
You choose to attack
from the left?
Interesting strategy.

You are attacking
from the right?

Probably not what I
would have done.
lines.ru:
Я бы, пожалуй, так
не сделал.

lines.en:
A minimal attack
and a feeble effort.

I am appalled at your
lack of strength.

I'm sorry. Were you
trying to injure me?

You provide me with
mild amusement.

You are stronger than
my original estimate.
Aargh!!

Wait until I analyze
your attack patterns!

Very interesting--
and very painful.

I've suffered damage
to multiple systems!

Now you're starting
to make me angry!
AAAAHH!!

My superior tactics
will yet prevail!

The battle has ended
for me, it seems.
NOOOOO!!!

I have disgraced Duke
Logan with this loss.

Your victory is but a
statistical anomaly!
A rear attack?

A dishonorable yet
effective tactic!

Was that an attack
you just attempted?

You certainly didn't
expect THAT to hit.
lines.ru:
Ты же не думал, что
ЭТО попадёт.

lines.en:
Your futility is truly
a joy to behold!

Is there any method
to your madness?
What?!

I need to recalibrate
my weapons systems.

Your luck will run
out. It always does.
A rare tactical error.

I am merely biding
my time.
Uhhhh!!

You cannot defeat me
under any conditions!

My attacks will not
be absorbed so easily!
lines.ru:
Мои атаки так
просто не погасить!

lines.en: Foolish! So foolish!

A warrior makes his
own opportunities.
Hmmph!
Damn you!
Futile.

My next attack will
not be so lethargic!

I dedicate my victory
to Miss Claire!

Fools do not belong
on the battlefield.
lines.ru:
Глупцам не место на
поле боя.

lines.en:
You were an inferior
opponent.

Who will be the next
to taste defeat?
Ooooff!
Haaaah!
Attack initiated.

This attack should
prove sufficient.

Withdraw from this
battle at once.
Prepare yourself.
RAAARGH!!

I will send you to
your grave, fool!
lines.ru:
Я отправлю тебя в
могилу, глупец!

lines.en:
Leave this battle or
you shall suffer!

Bid farewell to your
ATAC and your life!
WAAUUGGHH!!
